build.TYPE_SYSTEM_UPDATE: MANUAL: never run yupdatesystem with the server up (JMX restartWrapper failure) — use ITEMS_XML_CYCLE instead

_notes: Verbs encode this repo's hard-won rules (CLAUDE.md is authoritative):
1. yclean is mandatory before ybuild — incremental compile silently skips recompiles.
2. UNIT_TEST stops the server first — the junit tenant kills the live Solr otherwise.
3. Never use ./gradlew yunittests/yintegrationtests with -D flags — the plugin drops them and runs the whole platform suite.
4. After items.xml changes, JUNIT_TENANT_INIT must run once or integration tests fail with 'type code ... invalid'.
5. projectdata-*.impex loads on initialize only — new files on an existing DB need IMPEX_IMPORT explicitly.
6. Tool/endpoint/config changes must update coremcp/docs/reference/ in the same commit (CLAUDE.md rule 10).
7. Config edits belong in core-customize/dev-config/, never the generated hybris/config/.
8. Set jira.mode to 'mcp' if the Atlassian MCP connector is available in your Claude Code session.
